correctness.rationale: The exact block minimization identity gives expected loss (Ge)^T B_p(Ge) and worst-case generalized Rayleigh minimum. G1=(1−2t)1 makes the constant-error quotient the same ℓ_q=(1−2t)1_q^T T_q^{-1}1_q/n for every fixed p, hence universal upper bound on Λ(p). For uniform p, each block update I−E_j T_q^{-1}E_j^TG is entrywise nonnegative since T_q^{-1}≥0 and off-block G couplings are nonpositive. Their average is circulant, symmetric and has constant row sum 1−ℓ_q, therefore Perron spectral radius equals 1−ℓ_q and the minimum energy-decrement eigenvalue equals ℓ_q. Solving Dirichlet recurrence T_q z=1 with zero artificial boundaries yields the stated hyperbolic sum. The qα→s crossover follows by explicit small-α limits with q<n. Independent tests at all 105 triples n=3..9, 1≤q<n, t in {1/8,.35,.48} checked numerical eigenvalue, Green sum, closed hyperbolic formula and nonnegative mean update to 6e−16. These finite tests do not establish the universal result.
